_comment: Project tracker. HARD RULE: this file never asserts that a development permit application exists. Only records confirmed by a primary source (a regulator decision, a municipal record, or a government publication) belong here, and each carries verificationStatus. Media-reported projects are NOT seeded — they reach the site through the live news feed where they are badged as reported coverage. See the 'No unverified project claims' section of MAINTENANCE.md.

confirmed.name: Greenlight Electricity Centre
confirmed.capacityNote: Electricity generation capacity, not data centre IT load.
confirmed.summary: AUC approval for an electricity generation facility in Sturgeon County, northeast of Edmonton, expected to serve growing data centre demand.
confirmed.caution: This is an approval for a generation facility under the Hydro and Electric Energy Act. It is not a data centre development permit and should not be read as one.
confirmed.verificationNote: Seeded from research summaries. Confirm the decision number and date against the AUC record before relying on this.

reportedNote: Empty by design. Projects that appear only in media coverage are not restated as fact here — read them in the news feed, where the outlet is named and the item is badged as reported.
